   - **Total Heat Demand**: 180.80 (households) + 176.49 (administrative) = **357.29 GWh/year**, compared to **61.22 GWh/year** of electricity.

   - **Biomass** (61.26 GWh/year) and **solar thermal** (215.4 GWh/year) could significantly reduce fossil fuel dependence for heating.

- **Expand Biomass and Solar Thermal**: Use 34.23 GWh (woody) + 27.03 GWh (non-woody) biomass and 215.4 GWh solar thermal for heating.

This analysis highlights Sion’s potential to transition toward renewable energy while addressing current demand gaps.
